import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int age;
        List<Edge> adjusted;
        Edge back;

        Node() {
            adjusted = new ArrayList<>();
            back = null;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        Node from, to;
        int flow;
        Edge opposite;

        Edge() {
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] adjustCache = new Edge[1000000];
    static int[] adjustResult = new int[1000000];
    static int adjustDepth = 0;

    static int adjust(Edge e, int d) {
        if (e == null) return d;
        d = adjust(e.from.back, Math.min(d, e.flow));
        e.flow -= d;
        e.opposite.flow += d;
        return d;
    }

    static void connect(Node a, Node b, int w) {
        Edge ea = new Edge();
        Edge eb = new Edge();
        ea.from = a; ea.to = b; ea.flow = w; ea.opposite = eb;
        eb.from = b; eb.to = a; eb.flow = 0; eb.opposite = ea;
        a.adjusted.add(ea);
        b.adjusted.add(eb);
    }

    static int maxFlow(List<Node> g, Node source, Node sink) {
        int result = 0;
        while (true) {
            for (Node u : g) u.age = 0;
            Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(source);
            source.age = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && sink.age == 0) {
                Node u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : u.adjusted) {
                    Node v = e.to;
                    if (v.age != 0 || e.flow == 0) continue;
                    v.back = e;
                    v.age = u.age + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
            if (sink.age == 0) break;
            for (Edge e : sink.adjusted) {
                Edge o = e.opposite;
                if (o.from.age != sink.age - 1 || o.flow == 0) continue;
                result += adjust(o, o.flow);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long n;

    static long linear(long t, long r, long c) {
        return t * n * n + r * n + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null && !line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
            n = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
            long T = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);

            List<Node> g = new ArrayList<>((int)((T + 1) * n * n + 2));
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)((T + 1) * n * n + 2); i++) {
                g.add(new Node());
            }

            Node source = g.get((int)(linear(T, n-1, n-1) + 1));
            Node sink = g.get((int)(linear(T, n-1, n-1) + 2));

            List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
            String[] lab = new String[(int)n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                lab[i] = br.readLine().trim();
            }

            for (long r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                for (long c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    char ch = lab[(int)r].charAt((int)c);
                    if (ch == 'Y') continue;
                    if (ch == 'Z') {
                        z.add(new long[]{r, c});
                        continue;
                    }
                    connect(source, g.get((int)linear(0, r, c)), ch - '0');
                    lab[(int)r] = lab[(int)r].substring(0, (int)c) + '0' + lab[(int)r].substring((int)c + 1);
                }
            }

            String[] rowInput = new String[(int)n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                rowInput[i] = br.readLine().trim();
            }

            for (long r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                for (long c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    char ch = rowInput[(int)r].charAt((int)c);
                    if (ch == 'Y' || ch == 'Z') continue;
                    connect(g.get((int)linear(T, r, c)), sink, ch - '0');
                }
            }

            long[] dr = {1, 0, -1, 0};
            long[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

            for (long t = 0; t < T; t++) {
                for (long r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                    for (long c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        connect(g.get((int)linear(t, r, c)), g.get((int)linear(t + 1, r, c)), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        if (lab[(int)r].charAt((int)c) != '0') continue;
                        for (long d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            long r_ = r + dr[(int)d];
                            long c_ = c + dc[(int)d];
                            if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[(int)r_].charAt((int)c_) != '0')
                                continue;
                            connect(g.get((int)linear(t, r, c)), g.get((int)linear(t + 1, r_, c_)), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }

                List<long[]> z_ = new ArrayList<>();
                for (long[] e : z) {
                    long r = e[0];
                    long c = e[1];
                    for (long d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        long r_ = r + dr[(int)d];
                        long c_ = c + dc[(int)d];
                        if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[(int)r_].charAt((int)c_) != '0')
                            continue;
                        z_.add(new long[]{r_, c_});
                        lab[(int)r_] = lab[(int)r_].substring(0, (int)c_) + 'Z' + lab[(int)r_].substring((int)c_ + 1);
                    }
                }
                z = z_;
            }

            System.out.println(maxFlow(g, source, sink));
        }
    }
}
